newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firm, market for pipeline spec strong.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firm, market for pipeline spec strong.

text.p: NWE physical naphtha recovered from early swaps-inspired weakness to finish Friday on the strong note that characterised the market earlier in the week, traders said.

Swaps were still talked some $2 lower in a thin market, but the physical market was firm with two prompt piepline spec cargoes offered at around $232 a tonne cif NWE and a trading house bidding at $229 but set to go higher.
Some traders said the bidder was nursing a long swaps position.
